title: Exact recognition of bounded clique-width
formal: For every fixed k, can one decide in polynomial time whether a finite graph has clique-width at most k?
context:
Approximate decompositions and recognition of bounded rank-width do not give exact clique-width recognition. The exponent may depend on k; this is weaker than asking for FPT.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Tests whether a major dense-graph width parameter admits efficient exact recognition at every fixed value.
